def VTask.piEquivPiSubtypeProd {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (β : α → Type v) [DecidablePred p] :
  ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : {x // p x}) → β ↑i) × ((i : {x // ¬p x}) → β ↑i) :=
  { toFun := λ f => (λ s => f s.val, λ s => f s.val),
    invFun := λ pr => λ x, if hx : p x then pr.1 ⟨x, hx⟩ else pr.2 ⟨x, hx⟩,
    left_inv := by
      intro f
      ext x
      dsimp [toFun, invFun]
      splitIfs
      rfl,
    right_inv := by
      intro pr
      apply Prod.ext
      · ext s
        dsimp [toFun, invFun]
        simp only [if_pos s.prop]
        rfl
      · ext s
        dsimp [toFun, invFun]
        simp only [if_neg s.prop]
        rfl }
